name: bodyweight muscle up v. 2
description: An advanced pull-up that transitions into a dip above a bar. It builds serious pulling and pushing strength.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a false or standard grip.
Pull explosively, bringing the bar toward your lower chest.
Lean forward and rotate your wrists over the bar.
Press up until your arms are fully straight.
Lower yourself back down with control.
